title: ci: consolidate redundant workflows and remove placeholder tests
body:
CI has redundant workflows doing duplicate full builds and placeholder tests adding no value. This consolidates overlapping workflows (14→12) and removes trivial tests (215→211 files).

### Workflow consolidation

- **`size-check.yml` merged into `performance-budget.yml`** → renamed `bundle-analysis.yml`. Both were doing independent full `pnpm build` to check bundle sizes. Now one build serves both console perf budget and per-package size report.
- **`visual-regression.yml` merged into `storybook-tests.yml`**. Both built all packages, built Storybook, and installed Playwright independently. Visual regression now runs as a conditional step (`if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'`).

### E2E build artifact reuse

The E2E job had `needs: build` but still ran `pnpm turbo run build` (~3.5min). Now the build job uploads artifacts and E2E downloads them:

```yaml
# build job
- uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
  with:
    name: build-output
    path: |
      packages/*/dist
      apps/console/dist

# e2e job
- uses: actions/download-artifact@v4.1.3
  with:
    name: build-output
```

Pinned to `v4.1.3` to address arbitrary file write vulnerability in `actions/download-artifact` < 4.1.3.

### Docs job skip on non-docs PRs

Docs build (~3min) now checks `git diff` against `apps/site/` and `content/` paths. Skips all subsequent steps when no docs files changed.

### Removed placeholder tests

| File | Content |
|------|---------|
| `packages/{react,core,components}/src/index.test.ts` | `expect(true).toBe(true)` — zero value |
| `packages/plugin-grid/src/VirtualGrid.test.tsx` | 23-line export check, superseded by 438-line `__tests__/VirtualGrid.test.tsx` |

All 211 remaining test files pass (3993 tests, 2 skipped).
